help.title: HELP
help.text:
V-OS NET IS A SMALL BBS FOR V-OS, THE GRAPHICAL SYSTEM OF THE AMSTRAD CPC 6128, AND FOR ANY TELNET CLIENT.

IN THE MENUS GIVE A NUMBER AND RETURN; RETURN ALONE GOES BACK.

BOARDS: N A NEW THREAD, R A REPLY. A TEXT ENDS WITH A . ALONE ON ITS LINE.

CHAT: /WHO, /ME, /QUIT.

IN THE MENU: TERM V-OS|UTF8|ASCII, LANG, PASSWORD.

FROM V-OS: TELNET, CONNECT, {0}
(OR {0}:2323).
